treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Cyprus and the Government of the Republic of Poland for the Avoidance of Double Taxation with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital (1992, as amended by Protocol 2012)
eif_quote: Cyprus MLI position Art. 2 list: "Republic of Poland Original 04-06-1992 07-07-1993 Amending Instrument - Protocol (a) 22-03-2012 09-11-2012"
source_title: Protocol of 22.03.2012 amending the CY-PL Agreement of 4 June 1992, Greek/Polish/English texts, Cyprus Official Gazette Annex VII (gov.cy MoF scan)

rates.quote: 2. However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed: a) 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends for an uninterrupted period of twenty four months;

2. However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed: b) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

2. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Dividend 0% tier requires an uninterrupted holding period of twenty-four months (modelled as 730 days). Protocol (signed 22.03.2012, in force 09.11.2012) Art. 12(a): effective for taxes withheld at source on income derived on or after 1 January of the calendar year following the year of entry into force -> 2013-01-01. Original 1992 text (English part is a rotated scan) not re-read for other paragraphs of Arts. 10-12 (e.g. any government interest exemption). MLI covered (CY and PL); Cyprus reserved MLI Art. 8 entirely; PPT from mli_wht_effective per treaties_merged.json.
